hero.subtitle: Providing quality, affordable, and reliable waste collection services across Western Macedonia.

about.heading: A leading waste management company dedicated to sustainable solutions for a greener world.

pillars.title: Our Vision
pillars.body: A North Macedonia where waste is managed responsibly at every level — from households to industrial sites — creating cleaner public spaces for generations to come.

pillars.title: Our Mission
pillars.body: To provide quality, affordable waste collection services that communities can depend on. Punctual pickups, clear communication, and a genuine commitment to the environment.

pillars.title: Our Work
pillars.body: From dumpster rentals and garbage pickups to full demolition waste removal, we handle every job with the same standard — whether a single household or a large construction site.

about_page.h1: Committed to a cleaner North Macedonia.
about_page.subtitle: Eco Living is a waste management company serving municipalities, businesses, and households across the Western Macedonia region — delivering reliable, affordable, and environmentally responsible collection services.
about_page.pull_quote: We believe proper waste management isn't a luxury — it's a foundation for healthy communities. Since our founding, we have worked alongside local governments, private companies, and residents to build systems that actually work: punctual pickups, clear communication, and a genuine commitment to reducing environmental impact.
about_page.values_heading: Our vision, mission, and work ethic.

values.title: A greener future for every community.
values.body: We envision a North Macedonia where waste is managed responsibly at every level — from households to industrial sites — creating cleaner public spaces and a healthier environment for generations to come.

values.title: Reliable service, delivered with care.
values.body: Our mission is to provide quality, affordable waste collection and management services that communities can depend on — showing up on time, treating every client with respect, and continuously improving how we operate.

values.title: Hands-on, local, and accountable.
values.body: From dumpster rentals and garbage pickups to full demolition waste removal, we handle every job with the same standard of professionalism — whether it is a single household or a large construction site across the region.

about_page.cta_heading: Let's build a cleaner solution together.
about_page.cta_body: Whether you need a recurring pickup schedule or a one-off container, reach out and we will get back to you within 24–48 hours.

contact_page.h1: We're here when you need us.
contact_page.subtitle: Reach out by phone or email — we respond within 24–48 hours and are happy to discuss any waste management need, big or small.
contact_page.form_sub: Fill in the form and a member of our team will get back to you shortly.
contact_page.map_heading: Based in Gostivar, serving the region.
contact_page.map_body: We operate across the Western Macedonia region, covering Gostivar, Chegrane, Brvenitsa, and Želino.
contact_page.social_text: Follow us on social media for updates and project highlights.

garbage_pickup.title: Waste collection that fits your property.
garbage_pickup.subtitle: Regular collection for households, shared residential properties, and businesses in our service area.
garbage_pickup.blurb: A useful collection plan starts with the waste your property produces. We agree the waste types, collection point, vehicle access, and pickup frequency before arranging the service. Routine household and commercial waste, bulky items, and construction debris need different arrangements, so tell us what you need removed.
garbage_pickup.features_heading: A collection plan built around your needs
garbage_pickup.cta_body: Send us your location, property type, and approximate waste volume. We will confirm coverage and discuss a suitable collection schedule.

features.title: Agreed pickup schedule
features.description: Plan collection frequency around your household or business, with the collection point and access agreed in advance.

features.title: Clear waste categories
features.description: Tell us whether you have mixed household waste or separated materials so we can confirm the appropriate collection arrangement.

features.title: Homes and businesses
features.description: Collection planning for homes, shared properties, shops, offices, and other commercial premises.

features.title: Larger loads by arrangement
features.description: Furniture, renovation debris, and unusually large loads should be discussed separately from your routine pickup.

preparation.heading: Before arranging collection
items: Share your address and the type of property.
Describe the waste and how often it accumulates.
Tell us where the collection vehicle can stop.

dumpster_rental.title: Make room for your project’s waste.
dumpster_rental.subtitle: Container rental for renovations, construction work, and property clearouts, with delivery and collection arranged around your site.
dumpster_rental.blurb: The right container depends on more than volume. Heavy rubble, lighter bulky items, available space, and vehicle access all affect the choice. Tell us what your project involves and we will confirm the available container, accepted materials, loading limits, rental period, and collection arrangements before delivery.
dumpster_rental.features_heading: Plan the container around the job
dumpster_rental.cta_body: Share the location, materials, estimated quantity, and preferred dates. We will confirm the available sizes and the space needed for delivery.

features.title: Size and load guidance
features.description: Choose a container based on waste volume and weight. Confirm its exact dimensions and load limit before reserving space.

features.title: Delivery and collection
features.description: Agree where the container will stand and how the collection vehicle will reach it, including access for removal when full.

features.title: An agreed rental period
features.description: Arrange the hire period around the work. Contact us if your dates change or you need another collection.

features.title: Accepted materials
features.description: Describe rubble, soil, timber, or bulky items when booking. Ask before adding liquids, chemicals, asbestos, or other specialist waste.

preparation.heading: Before the container arrives
items: Send a description or photos of the materials.
Confirm a suitable standing area and vehicle access.
Discuss placement permission if you need public space.

house_demolition.title: Plan the demolition. Clear the site.
house_demolition.subtitle: Demolition and debris removal for residential projects, with the scope agreed after reviewing the property and access.
house_demolition.blurb: Every demolition project starts with the building and its surroundings. We discuss what needs removing, nearby properties, site access, and how the debris will be collected. Permissions, utility disconnections, and any materials needing specialist handling must be addressed before work begins.
house_demolition.features_heading: From site planning to debris removal
house_demolition.cta_body: Send the location, photos, and a description of the work. We will discuss the site assessment and the scope to include in your quote.

features.title: Site and access review
features.description: Review the property, access for equipment, and surrounding areas before agreeing the work.

features.title: A defined scope
features.description: Confirm which structures or parts of the building are included and what needs to stay in place.

features.title: Debris collection
features.description: Plan the loading and removal of demolition material alongside the work, keeping waste streams clear.

features.title: Site handover
features.description: Agree the cleanup and handover condition in the quote so you know what to expect when the work ends.

preparation.heading: Before requesting a quote
items: Share photos and the location of the building.
Describe what should be demolished and retained.
Tell us the status of permissions and utility connections.

septic_tank_cleaning.title: A practical service for your septic tank.
septic_tank_cleaning.subtitle: Emptying and cleaning for septic tanks and cesspools at homes and commercial properties in our service area.
septic_tank_cleaning.blurb: Septic service involves removing accumulated wastewater and sludge; it is separate from clearing a blocked drain. Tell us the tank location, approximate capacity, last emptying date, and any current problems. We use these details to plan access and agree the work needed for your property.
septic_tank_cleaning.cta_body: Share your location, tank details, and vehicle access. If the tank is overflowing, call us to discuss the situation and current availability.

features.title: Vacuum pumping
features.description: Vacuum pumping removes accumulated wastewater and sludge, with the scope agreed for the tank and its condition.

features.title: Access planning
features.description: Confirm the access cover location and where the service vehicle can safely stop before the visit.

features.title: Recurring maintenance
features.description: Discuss an emptying schedule based on the tank’s use, capacity, and previous service history.

features.title: Wastewater removal
features.description: Include collection and onward handling of the removed wastewater in the agreed service arrangements.

preparation.heading: Useful details for booking
items: Locate the access cover without entering the tank.
Share the capacity and last emptying date, if known.
Describe overflow, slow drainage, or recurring problems.

sewer_drainage_cleaning.title: Get your drains flowing again.
sewer_drainage_cleaning.subtitle: Drain and sewer unblocking for homes, shared residential buildings, and commercial properties.
sewer_drainage_cleaning.blurb: Slow drainage and wastewater backing up can have different causes. Tell us which drains are affected, whether the problem is recurring, and where the access points are. We discuss the suitable clearing method and scope before the visit. Cleaning removes obstructions; a damaged pipe may need separate repair.
sewer_drainage_cleaning.features_heading: A clear plan for blocked drains
sewer_drainage_cleaning.cta_heading: Tell us where the blockage is.
sewer_drainage_cleaning.cta_body: Share the location, affected drains, and symptoms. For active wastewater backups, call us to discuss the problem and availability.

features.title: High-pressure water cleaning
features.description: Water jetting clears grease, sludge, and other deposits, with the method selected for the pipe and obstruction.

features.title: Grease and sediment buildup
features.description: Discuss cleaning for deposits that restrict flow in household or commercial drainage systems.

features.title: Shared and commercial drains
features.description: Coordinate access for apartment buildings, workplaces, and other properties with shared drainage.

features.title: Recurring drainage problems
features.description: Describe previous blockages so we can discuss cleaning and whether further investigation or repair is needed.

preparation.heading: Before contacting the team
items: List the drains affected and when the problem began.
Tell us about manholes and other accessible points.
Mention previous clearing work or known pipe damage.

house_cleaning.title: A cleaner home, with a clear plan.
house_cleaning.subtitle: One-off and recurring home cleaning, with the rooms, priorities, and visit agreed around your needs.
house_cleaning.blurb: Whether you need help with everyday cleaning or a more thorough visit, start with the areas that matter most. We agree the rooms, surfaces, and tasks before booking. For a move or renovation, describe the condition of the property so cleaning can be planned separately from any bulky waste or rubble removal.
house_cleaning.cta_body: Tell us your location, approximate floor area, and priorities. We will discuss the scope and an available appointment.

features.title: One-off thorough cleaning
features.description: Agree the rooms and tasks for a more detailed clean, including areas that need extra attention.

features.title: Recurring home cleaning
features.description: Discuss a repeat schedule for the everyday cleaning tasks your home needs.

features.title: Moving and renovation cleaning
features.description: Plan cleaning for an empty home or after renovation, with dust and surface condition discussed first.

features.title: Agreed priorities
features.description: Confirm surfaces, access, supplies, and any special instructions before the team arrives.

preparation.heading: Help us plan the visit
items: Share the floor area and number of rooms.
List priority tasks and any delicate surfaces.
Mention renovation dust or items needing separate removal.

service_ui.contact_hint: Share your location and a few details so we can discuss the right service.

container_guide.heading: A guide to common container sizes
container_guide.intro: These capacities are used by local waste operators. Choose around the materials, weight, and space at your site; confirm the available unit before booking.
container_guide.note: Dimensions may vary by container model. Confirm the space needed for delivery when booking.
